Criminal Case No. 91 of 2025

Aman Yadav
 Versus
 The State Of Madhya Pradesh
 Appearance:
 Shri Abhishek Tiwari- Advocate for the applicant.
Shri Arvind Singh- Government Advocate for respondent/State

Order 
This is repeat (second) application filed by the applicant under Section 439 of Cr.P.C. (new Section 483 of the Bhartiya Nagrik Suraksha Sanhita, 2023) for grant of regular bail relating to FIR No.136/2024 registered at Police Station Budhni, District Sehore (M.P.) for the offences under Sections 386, 115, 420, 392, 120B and 34 of Indian Penal Code.
2. Earlier application filed by applicant was dismissed as withdrawn.
3. Learned counsel appearing for applicant submitted that applicant is in jail since 13.04.2024.
It is further submitted that complainant has been examined in Court and he is hostile.
Applicant is innocent and falsely been implicated.
In these circumstances, applicant be released on bail.
4. Learned Government Advocate appearing for State opposed the prayer but could not deny the position that complainant has turned hostile in Court.
It is further submitted that applicant is having two criminal antecedents of theft.
In these circumstances, applicant may not be released on bail.

5. Heard the counsel for the parties.
